items.desc: Don't rewrite it in Rust. Rewrite the 5% that's slow: profile Python, Node or Ruby apps, port the hot functions with your coding agent, prove they behave the same.
Lint the rendered UI: catches overflowing text, low contrast, overlaps, broken responsive layouts, emoji icons and more in any web framework. Built for AI coding agents.
Claude Code plugin: game sprites at your game's exact camera angle, drawn in your art style - props, 8-direction walking characters, characters seated on your own chairs (3D-guided)
